subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection intentionally use reset-focused ordering in its normal menu-bar item while Overview highest-usage ranks the maximum-used supported quota lane?
rationale: Current main and its tests establish skip-exhausted behavior, while the PR introduces two context-specific meanings for automatic selection; source inspection cannot determine the intended user contract.

options.title: Approve context-specific semantics
options.body: Keep reset-focused selection for the normal status item and maximum-usage selection for Overview, with explicit regression and live proof for both consumers.

options.title: Use one shared winning lane
options.body: Resolve both consumers through the same quota lane so provider ranking and displayed percentage cannot diverge.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Retain the skip-exhausted automatic behavior and close or redesign the change if exhausted lanes should not replace actionable remaining quota.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific semantics
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused selection for the normal status item and maximum-usage selection for Overview, with explicit regression and live proof for both consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available owner for the unresolved menu-bar product semantics and was directly requested to decide them.
